newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Explorers Index jumps on oil interest.
newsitem.headline: Australian Explorers Index jumps on oil interest.

text.p: Perth stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index jumped 103.1 points or 3.73 percent last week. The All Ordinaries Index rose 1.35 percent.
Aug 1 Jul 25 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.

Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary that the junior oil and gas sector remained popular with 'spec' investors while the Kalgoorlie Diggers and Dealers Forum failed to stimulate interest in all but gold producers. Advances outnumbered declines three to two.

Of the junior oils, Frontier Petroleum NL jumped 2.4 cents to 7.8 cents, Pacrim Energy NL up four cents to 14 cents, Anzoil NL kicked two cents to 7.5 cents, Maple Oil NL lifted 3.5 cents to 13.5 cents, Vic Petroleum NL continued its better performance up 4.5 cents to 25 cents and Amity Oil NL leapt 22 cents to
Falls included Wells Gold Corp NL down three cents to 5.1 cents, Bendigo Mining NL down 7.5 cents to 16.5 cents and Intrepid Mining Corp NL off 4.5 cents to 12.5 cents.

Star Mining Corp NL returned to the boards this week after an extended suspension period, falling 7.5 cents to 10.5 cents. Also to be relisted this week was Wattle Gully Gold Mines NL, which has purchased the Hill 50 Gold Mine and gone ex-bonus with a one-for-four issue of options.
